findings.title: Call the passkeys helper with its required user argument
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method defined in its superclass is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user). This does not compile, preventing the services module and the PR from building. Pass context.getUser() or provide a matching overload.

findings.title: Preserve conditional passkeys for login before a user is identified
findings.body: The new helper requires user != null, and both initial form rendering and error challenges now use it. On a normal login, context.getUser() is null, so fillContextForm() is no longer called and the page receives neither conditional WebAuthn UI attributes nor a WebAuthn challenge. This disables the existing username-less passkey login path (including for passkey-only users) and contradicts the existing discoverable-key login tests. Enable passkeys for unidentified users as well as for re-authentication.
